skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Gratitude Gift
skins.content: Formal wear that Qanipalaat got on holiday/Gratitude Gift. Always one to gift Sami specialties, he's now received a gift in return. He smiled to learn that Victorian garb went well with his tail.
skins.quote: The specialties Qanipalaat hands out are often eccentric. Other operators may not be able to appreciate the terrifying dried totems or the pungent fermented food, but they recognize a gesture of friendship from an ancient civilization.
